key.autotrader.add_trade: Add selected trade to auto list
key.autotrader.drift_view: Toggle camera glide on villager gui
autotrader.screen.title: AutoTrader settings
autotrader.option.discard_hint: On: products are thrown on the ground (result slot, plus matching bag stacks). Off: they go straight into your bag (shift click). Neither way touches the cursor
autotrader.option.price_refresh_hint: When a wanted trade gets stuck because the villager raised its price, closes and reopens the trade screen to refresh it. Only works on some servers (e.g. Leaf-style ones that reset the price when the screen is closed); a no-op on vanilla-like servers
autotrader.option.auto_open_gui_hint: Within 10 s of joining, opens the trade screen of the nearest reachable villager; gives up if none is around in those 10 s. Off by default
autotrader.hotkey.capturing: Press a key to bind %s (Esc cancels)
autotrader.list.more: ... and %s more (remove some to see them)
autotrader.msg.no_selection: Select a trade in the villager screen first
autotrader.msg.no_offer_matched: No tradable offer matches your auto list
autotrader.msg.config_repaired: Config file could not be read - kept as autotrader.json.broken, defaults restored
autotrader.msg.drift_on: Camera glide on villager gui enabled
autotrader.msg.drift_off: Camera glide on villager gui disabled
autotrader.msg.cursor_busy: Something is on your cursor - auto trading is waiting. Put it down (or drop it) and it continues
autotrader.msg.price_refresh: Price looks inflated - reopening the villager to reset it
autotrader.msg.price_refresh_failed: Could not reopen the villager - carrying on
